name: corpusiq
description: Remote MCP server for business data. Ask one question in plain language and get a single answer drawn from the systems a business already runs, including QuickBooks, Stripe, Shopify, HubSpot, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads and Search Console. Connected platforms are queried on demand with read-only access and every answer carries its sources.

http.description: Hosted streamable HTTP server. Sign in with OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration and PKCE, no pre-registration needed), connect the accounts you want to query, then ask questions across them.

examples.title: Cross-source revenue check
examples.description: Reconcile the same period across payments, store and accounting
examples.prompt: What did I collect last month across Stripe and Shopify, and does that match what QuickBooks reports for the same period?

examples.title: Campaign to order
examples.description: Connect ad spend to actual orders rather than clicks
examples.prompt: Which Google Ads campaigns produced the most Shopify orders last quarter, and what did they cost per order?

examples.title: Monthly summary with sources
examples.description: One page pulled from several systems at once
examples.prompt: Summarise last month: revenue, top acquisition channel and churn, and cite the system each number came from.

examples.title: Connection health
examples.description: Find stale or broken data connections before trusting a number
examples.prompt: Which connected accounts have not returned fresh data in the last 7 days?
